title: [review] tx_queue.py:400: pop() does not signal reservat
description: When pop() removes an entry, it never signals the entry's TxReservation. If a caller used push(return_reservation=True) and awaits reservation.wait(), they will hang indefinitely because the reservation is never completed. The entry.reservation.set_result(True) call is missing before or after removing the entry.
close_reason: Fixed: pop() now signals entry.reservation.set_result(True) before returning data, preventing callers awaiting reservation.wait() from hanging indefinitely
